name: witness
description: Proves a change of an iOS app in the simulator (xcodebuild and xcrun, with a read-only git check, scripted navigation by deep link or UI test) or of a local web page in a headless Chromium-family browser: runs the tests, installs and launches the app, takes a screenshot and writes a dated report; compares a before and an after proof.

interface.shortDescription: Prove an iOS change in the simulator or a local web page change in a headless browser.
interface.longDescription: Runs the tests of an Xcode project on a named simulator, installs and launches the app (optionally reaching a screen by deep link or UI test), or screenshots a local web page in a headless Chromium-family browser with a fresh profile; takes a screenshot and writes a dated report with the commit, the simulator or browser, the test result and the measured durations; compares a before and an after proof. Refuses to run in a main checkout.
defaultPrompt: Prove this iOS change in the simulator.
Prove this local web page change in a headless browser.
